subject: Gatehouse coordination: monthly pipeline hygiene & leadership packet
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Managers Distribution <managers@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: FinanceOps (finance-ops@acme.com)
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Gatehouse coordination: monthly pipeline hygiene & leadership packet

Team —

Quick heads-up and checklist for this month’s pipeline hygiene sprint (we're calling this the "Gatehouse" cadence to keep it distinct from routine scrubs). Goal: finalize manager-reviewed commits and assemble the condensed leadership packet by EOD Monday so Finance can validate the numbers for the QBR.

Top asks (please action by the deadlines below):

1) Stage updates: update stage and confidence for all active opportunities > $50k in Salesforce. Use the Manager_Roster.csv to confirm stage owner. (Due: Monday 10/18 11:59 PT)
2) Commit confirmations: mark commits as "Confirmed" or "At Risk" in the Gatehouse_Hygiene_Checklist.xlsx with a 1-sentence rationale for any At Risk items. (Due: Monday 10/18 11:59 PT)
3) Leadership packet: upload a 1-slide summary per commit using the Leadership_Packet_Template.pptx link in Drive. Keep it to 3 bullets (threats, next steps, ask). We'll compile these into the exec sheet. (Due: Tuesday 10/19 2:00 PT)

Notes:
- FinanceOps is copied to flag any timing constraints for validation. Sarah (CustCo) is on the distribution for visibility on the large renewal.
- If you anticipate a material change to already-forecasted ARR, flag with a short note in the checklist and ping me directly.
- We will run a 20-minute manager roll call Monday at 12:30 PT to surface blockers — calendar invite to follow.

Attachments included: Gatehouse_Hygiene_Checklist.xlsx, Leadership_Packet_Template.pptx, Manager_Roster.csv

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Managers Distribution <managers@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Gatehouse coordination: monthly pipeline hygiene & leadership packet

Lauren — thanks for the clear asks. A couple quick items: 

- I’ll own compiling the leadership slides into the exec master once teams upload. Please confirm whether you want the raw PPTX files or if a single exported PDF is preferred for the deck.
- For Manager_Roster.csv, I noticed a few owners are missing territories — I’ll push an updated roster by EOD today.
- One ask from my side: can we set a hard flag for newly-created opportunities after the scrub window? We should avoid late-stage additions that bypass the Gatehouse review. Happy to document the rule if you want.

I’ve attached an annotated copy of the checklist with two example rows filled for demonstration.

—Marcus
Senior Sales Manager

(Attachment stub: Gatehouse_Hygiene_Checklist_annotated.xlsx)

Quick update from my team:

- Stage updates: 90% complete — two large renewals still awaiting legal redlines (listed in the checklist).
- Commits: flagged three deals as At Risk with short rationale in the sheet; one deal (ACME-34921) needs finance validation on payment terms.
- Decks: my managers will upload slide(s) by noon PT.

Also: the Monday roll call is tight for a couple of managers in EMEA — can we capture an asynchronous channel (thread in Slack) for questions and let them confirm via the checklist?

Thanks,
Grace
Revenue Manager

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: FinanceOps (finance-ops@acme.com), Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@custco.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2027 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Gatehouse coordination: monthly pipeline hygiene & leadership packet

Appreciate the proactive runbook. Two quick asks from leadership before you close the packet: 

1) Please include a one-line ARR delta for each commit in the final exec table (i.e., confirmed delta vs prior forecast). That makes the reconciliation with FinanceOps faster.
2) For any At Risk deals > $250k, add a 1-sentence mitigation plan and the name of the individual who will own the mitigation.

If teams hit the deadlines, we should be fine to get Finance sign-off Wednesday morning. If anything slips, call it out in the first slide of the packet so the exec readout can re-prioritize.

Jonas
VP Revenue Operations
